name: claude-remote
description: List local coding sessions and resume one through the claude CLI when send is enabled.
author: thecsguy <thecsguy@mail.grokbot.com>

scripts.test: export CLAUDE_REMOTE_SPAWN_GUARD=1; tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:+$NODE_OPTIONS }--require ${PWD}/test/spawn-guard.cjs" tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts
